1

Avatar + Producto

Prompt del avatar basemétodo 6c
avatar base
A candid iPhone photo of two female podcast hosts in their early 20s with an Instagram influencer, model-level aesthetic. The woman on the left has long wavy dark hair, warm tan skin with visible freckles and natural pores, defined brows, soft glam makeup, and a confident subtle smile. She is wearing a burgundy asymmetrical sports bra with a front cutout and matching high-waisted leggings. The woman on the right has blonde hair loosely tied back with face-framing strands, light natural makeup, soft skin texture with realistic imperfections, and a relaxed smile. She is wearing a black asymmetrical sports bra with matching black leggings, white socks, and minimal jewelry.

iPhone photo, eye-level perspective, natural 26mm iPhone lens look, vertical framing, candid podcast setup, both women seated comfortably in cozy cream boucle chairs, looking directly at the camera with relaxed confident expressions.

Modern podcast studio with vertical walnut wood acoustic slat wall, silver creator awards mounted behind them, warm ambient table lamp, white backdrop roll, subtle purple LED accent light, wooden coffee table in the foreground with an open laptop and over-ear headphones, professional podcast microphones on boom arms positioned in front of each host.

Direct harsh iPhone flash mixed with warm ambient studio lighting, high contrast shadows, slight grain, candid dump vibe, authentic social media aesthetic, realistic skin texture with pores, freckles, and natural imperfections, crisp but unpolished smartphone realism.

Keep the composition, facial features, poses, outfits, lighting, camera angle, background layout, props, colors, and overall atmosphere identical to the reference image. Maintain realistic proportions, natural expressions, and authentic iPhone photo quality.

No text, no watermark, no distortion.

paneles.Recursos:
Herramientas y modelos

Si el avatar habla → Omni

Si el avatar no habla → Grok

Utiliza Omni cuando el avatar tenga que hablar y Grok cuando no necesite hablar. De esta forma conseguirás el resultado adecuado sin gastar más de lo necesario.

→

Herramientas generales

No necesitas utilizar todas estas herramientas. Puedes completar el proceso utilizando únicamente Google Flow, ApiMart u otra de las alternativas disponibles. Te mostramos diferentes opciones para que elijas la que mejor se adapte a ti.

  • Google FlowEl estudio de Google para imagen y vídeo (Veo): la herramienta recomendada del curso UGC.
  • CapCutMontaje final + la capa de realismo que hace que no parezca IA.
  • ApiMartMercado de APIs alternativo a KIE; aquí viven VEO 3.1 y Omni Flash.
  • KIE (kie.ai)Mercado de APIs de generación: acceso a los modelos de vídeo e imagen a una fracción del precio oficial.
  • ElevenLabsVoces realistas para los avatares y la voz en off.
